contract.name: casepath_observable_claim
contract.rule: Pass this object—and only this object—to downstream inference.

customer_message.body:
Hello

Given the unusual circumstance: The heating has been barely warm for three nights; On the phone I was only told that the part is on order; The living-room thermometer shows 15 to 17 degrees but is not calibrated, and the portable units barely cover the night; this is what my overview shows.

Regarding “repeated boiler failure during freezing weather in a vulnerable household”, my overview shows: the calibrated indoor temperature remains unresolved; for the request “secure emergency heating, a service report and a firm repair plan, and review the safeguards for an official deposit”: I currently have only part of the records; on “repeated boiler failure during freezing weather in a vulnerable household”, I want a traceable assessment; also unresolved: the replacement part delivery; I cannot currently support anything further.

My specific request is: secure emergency heating, a service report and a firm repair plan, and review the safeguards for an official deposit; in particular, I need clarity about the replacement part delivery and how the exceptional circumstance changes the route.

I became aware of the problem on 03 January 2025.

Thank you for reviewing carefully; I first need to understand the calibrated indoor temperature; I want to base what I do on that.

Best regards
customer_message.subject: Unusual circumstances: repeated boiler failure during freezing weather in a vulnerable household
